differences.what: The five long-wall sash and far-end door replace the generic house opening order; the pictured near gable is now blank. These count/topology differences are fixed.

The missing open four-post belfry, arches, crossed lower rails, concave cap, bell and cross are present. The body roof is lower, the belfry slimmer and taller, and the single stack is at the far roof end. Their presence and shapes are reconstructed for 1835, not attested to that date.

The generic low house-window setout is fixed: only the five pictured long-wall sash rise 0.45 m, with reconstructed sill 1.40 m and head 2.8322 m at the retained 3.2 m wall. Their count, full width/height, horizontal stations and the far door remain unchanged. The actual same-camera comparison now places their heads close beneath the eaves and above the door head, following the engraving. The selected height is a bounded reconstruction from same-wall proportions, not a calibrated historical measurement or dated 1835 setout.

The coarse camera/body-groundline mismatch is not a separate geometry defect. The initial steeper-roof fit had 72.87 px RMS/160.42 px maximum residual; the corrected roof is shown from the same camera. Pixel offsets and disagreements between camera fits are within tolerance under T3153. No surveyed placement or ground anchor was moved to fit the retrospective drawing.

A held unattributed sepia photograph appears to show three sash rather than five, but its identity, depicted date and rights have not been established. No geometry or licensed comparison asset was derived from it. The conflicting opening counts are disclosed as a picture/state disagreement; they do not independently create another OPEN geometry gap under T3153. The credited Moss engraving supplies the chosen five-sash topology.

The engraving is undated. Its filename ending in 1843 does not date it, and the text dates only the original 1833 tower absence and an undated later addition. The 1835 presence, profiles, scantlings and pitch remain reconstructed choices. The picture cannot establish the unseen far gable, interior, precise paint/metal colours, original-site installation date or relocation. These are disclosed limits, not automatic OPEN geometry gaps.
